name: appt_book
script:
# Server Script: appt_book
# type: API
# doctype: -
# event: Before Insert
# api_method: appt_book
# allow_guest: 1
# frequency: All
# disabled: 0

f = frappe.form_dict
mode = f.get("mode")

for k in ("practitioner", "appointment_type", "date", "time"):
    if not f.get(k):
        frappe.throw("Please complete all appointment details.")
if frappe.utils.getdate(f.get("date")) < frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today()):
    frappe.throw("Choose today or a later date.")

# Refuse the booking if the doctor already has an appointment overlapping this time
def to_min(t):
    parts = str(t).split(":")
    return int(parts[0]) * 60 + int(parts[1])

dur = frappe.db.get_value("Appointment Type", f.get("appointment_type"), "default_duration") or 0
new_start = to_min(f.get("time"))
new_end = new_start + max(int(dur), 10)
existing = frappe.get_all("Patient Appointment",
    filters={"practitioner": f.get("practitioner"), "appointment_date": f.get("date"), "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]},
    fields=["appointment_time", "duration"])
for b in existing:
    b_start = to_min(b.appointment_time)
    b_end = b_start + max(int(b.duration or 0), 10)
    if new_start < b_end and new_end > b_start:
        frappe.throw("This time slot is already booked. Please choose another time.")

if mode == "existing":
    patient = f.get("patient")
    if not patient or not frappe.db.exists("Patient", {"name": patient, "status": "Active"}):
        frappe.throw("Select the patient from the search results.")
else:
    first = (f.get("first_name") or "").strip()
    last = (f.get("last_name") or "").strip()
    dob = f.get("dob")
    mobile = (f.get("mobile") or "").strip()
    if not first or not f.get("sex"):
        frappe.throw("Please fill in first name and gender.")
    if dob or mobile:
        flt = {"first_name": first}
        if last:
            flt["last_name"] = last
        if dob:
            flt["dob"] = dob
        if mobile:
            flt["mobile"] = mobile
        if frappe.get_all("Patient", filters=flt, limit=1):
            frappe.throw("This patient already exists. Use 'I'm an existing patient' to find them.")
    p = frappe.new_doc("Patient")
    p.first_name = first
    p.last_name = last
    p.sex = f.get("sex")
    if dob:
        p.dob = dob
    p.mobile = mobile
    p.email = f.get("email")
    p.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    patient = p.name

a = frappe.new_doc("Patient Appointment")
a.patient = patient
a.appointment_for = "Practitioner"
a.practitioner = f.get("practitioner")
a.appointment_type = f.get("appointment_type")
a.appointment_date = f.get("date")
a.appointment_time = f.get("time")
a.company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
a.notes = f.get("notes")
a.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.response["message"] = {"appointment": a.name}

# Server Script: appt_search
# type: API
# doctype: -
# event: Before Insert
# api_method: appt_search
# allow_guest: 1
# frequency: All
# disabled: 0

MASK_MOBILE = False  # set True to show numbers like 98****3210

name = (frappe.form_dict.get("name") or "").strip()
mobile = (frappe.form_dict.get("mobile") or "").strip()
if len(name) < 2 and len(mobile) < 4:
    frappe.throw("Enter at least 2 letters of the name or 4 digits of the mobile number.")

filters = [["Patient", "status", "=", "Active"]]
if name:
    filters.append(["Patient", "patient_name", "like", "%" + name + "%"])
if mobile:
    filters.append(["Patient", "mobile", "like", "%" + mobile + "%"])

rows = frappe.get_all("Patient", filters=filters,
    fields=["name", "patient_name", "mobile", "dob"],
    order_by="patient_name", limit=10)

today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today())
out = []
for r in rows:
    age = None
    if r.dob:
        d = frappe.utils.getdate(r.dob)
        age = today.year - d.year - (1 if (today.month, today.day) < (d.month, d.day) else 0)
    m = r.mobile or ""
    if MASK_MOBILE and len(m) > 6:
        m = m[:2] + "****" + m[-4:]
    out.append({"id": r.name, "name": r.patient_name, "age": age, "mobile": m})
frappe.response["message"] = {"patients": out}

name: appt_slots
script:
# Server Script: appt_slots
# type: API
# doctype: -
# event: Before Insert
# api_method: appt_slots
# allow_guest: 1
# frequency: All
# disabled: 0

SLOT_MINUTES = 10
# Used only when the doctor has no schedule for that weekday (6 PM to 9 PM)
DEFAULT_WINDOWS = [[18 * 60, 21 * 60]]
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]

prac = frappe.form_dict.get("practitioner")
date = frappe.form_dict.get("date")
exclude = frappe.form_dict.get("exclude")
if not prac or not date:
    frappe.throw("Choose a doctor and a date.")

d = frappe.utils.getdate(date)
day = DAYS[d.weekday()]

# 1. Working hours from the doctor's Practitioner Schedule(s) for that weekday
windows = []
source = "schedule"
try:
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Healthcare Practitioner", prac)
    for row in doc.practitioner_schedules:
        sch = frappe.get_doc("Practitioner Schedule", row.schedule)
        for ts in sch.time_slots:
            if ts.day == day:
                a = str(ts.from_time).split(":")
                b = str(ts.to_time).split(":")
                windows.append([int(a[0]) * 60 + int(a[1]), int(b[0]) * 60 + int(b[1])])
except:
    windows = []
if not windows:
    windows = DEFAULT_WINDOWS
    source = "default"

# 2. Time already taken by booked appointments
busy = []
booked = frappe.get_all("Patient Appointment",
    filters={"practitioner": prac, "appointment_date": date, "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]},
    fields=["name", "appointment_time", "duration"])
for x in booked:
    if exclude and x.name == exclude:
        continue
    p = str(x.appointment_time).split(":")
    start = int(p[0]) * 60 + int(p[1])
    busy.append([start, start + max(int(x.duration or 0), SLOT_MINUTES)])

# 3. Hide times that have already passed today
now = 0
if d == frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today()):
    n = str(frappe.utils.now_datetime()).split(" ")[1].split(":")
    now = int(n[0]) * 60 + int(n[1])

# 4. Cut the working hours into 10-minute slots
slots = []
for w in windows:
    for t in range(w[0], w[1] - SLOT_MINUTES + 1, SLOT_MINUTES):
        if t < now:
            continue
        taken = False
        for b in busy:
            if t < b[1] and t + SLOT_MINUTES > b[0]:
                taken = True
        if not taken:
            slots.append(str(t // 60).zfill(2) + ":" + str(t % 60).zfill(2))

frappe.response["message"] = {"slots": sorted(set(slots)), "source": source}

# api_method: appt_update

if frappe.session.user == "Guest":
    frappe.throw("Log in with a staff account to edit appointments.")

f = frappe.form_dict
name = f.get("appointment")
patient = f.get("patient")
if not name or not patient:
    frappe.throw("Choose the appointment to edit.")

doc = frappe.get_doc("Patient Appointment", name)
if not doc.has_permission("write"):
    frappe.throw("You don't have permission to edit this appointment.")
if doc.patient != patient:
    frappe.throw("That appointment doesn't belong to this patient.")
if doc.status in ["Cancelled", "Closed"]:
    frappe.throw("This appointment can no longer be changed.")

today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today())
if frappe.utils.getdate(doc.appointment_date) < today:
    frappe.throw("Past appointments can't be changed.")
for k in ("practitioner", "appointment_type", "date", "time"):
    if not f.get(k):
        frappe.throw("Please complete all appointment details.")
if frappe.utils.getdate(f.get("date")) < today:
    frappe.throw("Choose today or a later date.")

def to_min(t):
    parts = str(t).split(":")
    return int(parts[0]) * 60 + int(parts[1])

dur = frappe.db.get_value("Appointment Type", f.get("appointment_type"), "default_duration") or 0
new_start = to_min(f.get("time"))
new_end = new_start + max(int(dur), 10)
others = frappe.get_all("Patient Appointment",
    filters={"practitioner": f.get("practitioner"), "appointment_date": f.get("date"),
             "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"], "name": ["!=", name]},
    fields=["appointment_time", "duration"])
for b in others:
    b_start = to_min(b.appointment_time)
    b_end = b_start + max(int(b.duration or 0), 10)
    if new_start < b_end and new_end > b_start:
        frappe.throw("This time slot is already booked. Please choose another time.")

doc.practitioner = f.get("practitioner")
doc.appointment_type = f.get("appointment_type")
doc.appointment_date = f.get("date")
doc.appointment_time = f.get("time")
doc.notes = f.get("notes")
if dur:
    doc.duration = int(dur)
doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.response["message"] = {"appointment": doc.name}

script:
# Server Script: desk_data
# type: API
# doctype: -
# event: Before Insert
# api_method: desk_data
# allow_guest: 0
# frequency: All
# disabled: 0

user = frappe.session.user
is_admin = False
if frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": user, "role": "Healthcare Administrator"}):
    is_admin = True
if frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": user, "role": "System Manager"}):
    is_admin = True
is_doctor = bool(frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": user, "role": "Physician"}))
if not (is_admin or is_doctor):
    frappe.throw("You don't have access to the doctor desk.")

date = frappe.form_dict.get("date") or frappe.utils.today()
mine = frappe.get_all("Healthcare Practitioner", filters={"user_id": user},
    fields=["name", "practitioner_name"], limit=1)

if mine and not is_admin:
    prac = mine[0].name
    practitioners = [mine[0]]
    can_pick = False
elif is_admin:
    prac = frappe.form_dict.get("practitioner") or ""
    practitioners = frappe.get_all("Healthcare Practitioner", filters={"status": "Active"},
        fields=["name", "practitioner_name"], order_by="practitioner_name")
    can_pick = True
else:
    frappe.throw("Your user isn't linked to a Healthcare Practitioner. Ask an administrator to set the User ID on your practitioner record.")

filters = {"appointment_date": date, "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]}
if prac:
    filters["practitioner"] = prac
rows = frappe.get_all("Patient Appointment", filters=filters,
    fields=["name", "patient", "patient_name", "practitioner", "practitioner_name",
            "appointment_time", "duration", "appointment_type", "status", "notes"],
    order_by="appointment_time asc")

info = {}
if rows:
    ids = []
    for r in rows:
        ids.append(r.patient)
    for p in frappe.get_all("Patient", filters={"name": ["in", ids]},
            fields=["name", "dob", "sex", "mobile"]):
        info[p.name] = p

def find_invoice(appt):
    try:
        for r in frappe.get_all("Sales Invoice Item",
                filters={"reference_dt": "Patient Appointment", "reference_dn": appt},
                fields=["parent"], limit=5):
            if frappe.db.get_value("Sales Invoice", r.parent, "docstatus") < 2:
                return r.parent
    except:
        pass
    found = frappe.get_all("Sales Invoice",
        filters={"remarks": ["like", "%Consultation: " + appt + "%"], "docstatus": ["<", 2]},
        fields=["name"], limit=1)
    if found:
        return found[0].name
    return ""

today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today())
out = []
for r in rows:
    p = info.get(r.patient)
    age = None
    sex = ""
    mobile = ""
    if p:
        sex = p.sex or ""
        mobile = p.mobile or ""
        if p.dob:
            d = frappe.utils.getdate(p.dob)
            age = today.year - d.year - (1 if (today.month, today.day) < (d.month, d.day) else 0)
    inv = ""
    if r.status in ["Closed", "Checked Out"]:
        inv = find_invoice(r.name)
    enc_found = frappe.get_all("Patient Encounter",
        filters={"appointment": r.name, "docstatus": ["!=", 2]}, fields=["name"], limit=1)
    has_encounter = bool(enc_found or r.status in ["Closed", "Checked Out"])
    t = str(r.appointment_time).split(":")
    out.append({
        "id": r.name, "patient": r.patient, "name": r.patient_name,
        "age": age, "sex": sex, "mobile": mobile,
        "practitioner": r.practitioner, "practitioner_name": r.practitioner_name,
        "time": t[0].zfill(2) + ":" + t[1], "duration": r.duration,
        "type": r.appointment_type, "status": r.status, "notes": r.notes or "", "invoice": inv,
        "has_encounter": has_encounter,
    })

statuses = []
for s in (frappe.get_meta("Patient Appointment").get_field("status").options or "").split("\n"):
    if s:
        statuses.append(s)

modes = []
for m in frappe.get_all("Mode of Payment", filters={"enabled": 1}, fields=["name"], order_by="name"):
    modes.append(m.name)

token = ""
try:
    token = frappe.session.get("csrf_token") or ""
except:
    token = ""

frappe.response["message"] = {
    "appointments": out, "practitioners": practitioners, "prac": prac,
    "can_pick": can_pick, "statuses": statuses, "csrf": token, "modes": modes,
}

name: desk_invoice
script:
# Server Script: desk_invoice
# type: API
# doctype: -
# event: Before Insert
# api_method: desk_invoice
# allow_guest: 0
# frequency: All
# disabled: 0

user = frappe.session.user
is_admin = False
if frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": user, "role": "Healthcare Administrator"}):
    is_admin = True
if frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": user, "role": "System Manager"}):
    is_admin = True
is_doctor = bool(frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": user, "role": "Physician"}))
if not (is_admin or is_doctor):
    frappe.throw("You don't have access to the doctor desk.")

# The Item billed for a consultation when the doctor's record names none. Change to your Item ID.
CONSULT_ITEM = "CONSULT-GEN"

def num(v):
    try:
        return float(v or 0)
    except:
        return 0.0

def find_invoice(appt):
    try:
        for r in frappe.get_all("Sales Invoice Item",
                filters={"reference_dt": "Patient Appointment", "reference_dn": appt},
                fields=["parent"], limit=5):
            if frappe.db.get_value("Sales Invoice", r.parent, "docstatus") < 2:
                return r.parent
    except:
        pass
    found = frappe.get_all("Sales Invoice",
        filters={"remarks": ["like", "%Consultation: " + appt + "%"], "docstatus": ["<", 2]},
        fields=["name"], limit=1)
    if found:
        return found[0].name
    return ""

name = frappe.form_dict.get("appointment")
mode = (frappe.form_dict.get("mode") or "").strip()
if not name:
    frappe.throw("Choose an appointment.")

appt = frappe.get_doc("Patient Appointment", name)
if not is_admin:
    mine = frappe.db.get_value("Healthcare Practitioner", {"user_id": user}, "name")
    if not mine or appt.practitioner != mine:
        frappe.throw("You can only bill your own appointments.")
if appt.status not in ["Closed", "Checked Out"]:
    frappe.throw("Complete the consultation before billing it.")

existing = find_invoice(appt.name)
if existing:
    frappe.response["message"] = {"invoice": existing, "created": False, "paid": False, "note": ""}
else:
    prac = frappe.get_doc("Healthcare Practitioner", appt.practitioner)
    item = prac.get("op_consulting_charge_item")
    if not item or not frappe.db.exists("Item", item):
        item = CONSULT_ITEM
    if not frappe.db.exists("Item", item):
        frappe.throw("Item " + item + " was not found. Create it, or change CONSULT_ITEM in the desk_invoice script.")
    rate = num(prac.get("op_consulting_charge"))
    if rate <= 0:
        rate = num(frappe.db.get_value("Item", item, "standard_rate"))
    if rate <= 0:
        frappe.throw("No consultation charge found. Set OP Consulting Charge on the doctor's record, or the Standard Selling Rate of item " + item + ".")

    company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
    co = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company,
        ["default_receivable_account", "default_income_account", "cost_center", "default_currency"], as_dict=True)

    cust = ""
    try:
        cust = frappe.db.get_value("Patient", appt.patient, "customer") or ""
    except:
        cust = ""
    if not cust:
        cust = "Walk-in Customer"
        if not frappe.db.exists("Customer", cust):
            c = frappe.new_doc("Customer")
            c.customer_name = cust
            c.customer_type = "Individual"
            c.customer_group = frappe.db.get_value("Customer Group", {"is_group": 0}, "name")
            c.territory = frappe.db.get_value("Territory", {"is_group": 0}, "name")
            c.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            cust = c.name

    uom = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item, "stock_uom")
    si = frappe.new_doc("Sales Invoice")
    si.customer = cust
    si.company = company
    si.posting_date = frappe.utils.today()
    si.update_stock = 0
    si.ignore_pricing_rule = 1
    si.currency = co.default_currency
    si.selling_price_list = frappe.db.get_single_value("Selling Settings", "selling_price_list") or "Standard Selling"
    si.price_list_currency = co.default_currency
    si.conversion_rate = 1
    si.plc_conversion_rate = 1
    si.remarks = "Consultation: " + appt.name + " " + (appt.patient_name or "")
    si.patient = appt.patient
    si.append("items", {"item_code": item, "qty": 1, "uom": uom, "stock_uom": uom, "conversion_factor": 1,
        "price_list_rate": rate, "rate": rate,
        "description": "Consultation with " + (prac.get("practitioner_name") or appt.practitioner),
        "income_account": co.default_income_account, "cost_center": co.cost_center})
    si.run_method("set_missing_values")
    if not si.debit_to:
        si.debit_to = co.default_receivable_account
    si.run_method("calculate_taxes_and_totals")
    si.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    si.submit()

    paid = False
    note = ""
    if mode and mode != "Credit":
        try:
            pe = frappe.call("erpnext.accounts.doctype.payment_entry.payment_entry.get_payment_entry",
                dt="Sales Invoice", dn=si.name)
            pe.mode_of_payment = mode
            pe.reference_no = si.name
            pe.reference_date = frappe.utils.today()
            pe.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            pe.submit()
            paid = True
        except:
            note = "The invoice is saved, but the payment could not be recorded. Record it from the invoice in Desk."
    frappe.response["message"] = {"invoice": si.name, "created": True, "paid": paid, "note": note}

if not ok:

doctype = (frappe.form_dict.get("doctype") or "").strip()
name    = (frappe.form_dict.get("name") or "").strip()

if not doctype or not name:
    frappe.throw("DocType and invoice name are required.")

if doctype not in ["Sales Invoice", "Purchase Invoice"]:
    frappe.throw("Invalid DocType.")

if not frappe.db.exists(doctype, name):
    frappe.throw(doctype + " not found: " + name)

doc = frappe.get_doc(doctype, name)

if doc.docstatus != 1:
    frappe.throw("Only submitted invoices can be edited.")

if doc.is_return:
    frappe.throw("Use the Return page to manage return notes.")

# Note: The original invoice is NOT cancelled here!
# It will only be cancelled and amended when the replacement is saved.

if doctype == "Sales Invoice":
    mode = "Cash"
    if doc.payments:
        mode = doc.payments[0].mode_of_payment

    items = []
    for it in doc.items:
        batch_no = it.batch_no or ""
        upp = 1
        mrp = it.rate
        net_rate = it.rate
        gst = 0
        exp = ""
        if batch_no and frappe.db.exists("Batch", batch_no):
            b = frappe.get_doc("Batch", batch_no)
            upp = int(b.units_per_pack or 1)
            mrp = float(b.mrp or it.rate)
            net_rate = float(b.net_rate or it.rate)
            gst = float(b.gst_rate or 0)
            if b.expiry_date:
                exp = str(b.expiry_date)

        packs = int(it.qty // upp)
        units = int(round(it.qty % upp))
        items.append({

            "name": it.item_name,
            "batch": batch_no,
            "packs": packs,
            "units": units,
            "qty": float(it.qty or 0),

            "disc": float(it.discount_percentage or 0),
            "upp": upp,

        })

    custom_charge = 0.0
    custom_charge_name = ""
    for tx in (doc.taxes or []):

            custom_charge = float(tx.tax_amount or 0)
            custom_charge_name = tx.description or ""
            break

    frappe.response["message"] = {

        "name": name,
        "customer": doc.customer or "",
        "patient": doc.patient or "",
        "date": str(doc.posting_date),
        "warehouse": doc.set_warehouse or "",
        "mode": mode,
        "charge": custom_charge,
        "charge_name": custom_charge_name,
        "items": items
    }

elif doctype == "Purchase Invoice":
    items = []
    for it in doc.items:
        batch_no = it.batch_no or ""
        upp = 1
        mrp = it.rate
        gst = 0
        exp = ""
        hsn = "3004"
        if batch_no and frappe.db.exists("Batch", batch_no):
            b = frappe.get_doc("Batch", batch_no)
            upp = int(b.units_per_pack or 1)
            mrp = float(b.mrp or it.rate)
            gst = float(b.gst_rate or 5)
            hsn = b.hsn_code or "3004"
            if b.expiry_date:
                exp = str(b.expiry_date)

        packs = int(it.qty // upp)
        units = int(round(it.qty % upp))
        items.append({
            "product": it.item_name or it.item_code,
            "batch": batch_no,
            "expiry": exp,
            "hsn": hsn,
            "gst": str(gst),
            "mrp": mrp,
            "rate": it.rate * upp,
            "basis": "excl",
            "upp": upp,
            "packs": packs,
            "units": units,
            "disc": 0,
            "amount": it.amount,
            "net": it.rate * upp
        })

    pay_status = "Paid"
    due_date = str(doc.due_date or "")
    paid_date = str(doc.posting_date or "")
    pay_mode = "Cash"
    paid_amt = float(doc.rounded_total or doc.grand_total or 0)

    if doc.outstanding_amount and doc.outstanding_amount > 0:
        if doc.outstanding_amount >= (doc.rounded_total or doc.grand_total):
            pay_status = "Due"
            paid_amt = 0

    pes = frappe.db.sql("""
        select distinct parent from `tabPayment Entry Reference`
        where reference_doctype='Purchase Invoice' and reference_name=%s and docstatus=1
    """, name, as_dict=True)
    if pes:

        pay_mode = pe.mode_of_payment
        paid_date = str(pe.posting_date)
        paid_amt = float(pe.paid_amount)

    courier = 0.0
    for tx in (doc.taxes or []):
        if "Courier" in (tx.description or "") or "Freight" in (tx.description or ""):
            courier += float(tx.tax_amount or 0)

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "doctype": doctype,
        "name": name,
        "supplier": doc.supplier or "",
        "bill_no": doc.bill_no or "",
        "bill_date": str(doc.bill_date or doc.posting_date),
        "warehouse": doc.set_warehouse or "",
        "discount_percentage": float(doc.additional_discount_percentage or 0),
        "discount_amount": float(doc.discount_amount or 0),
        "courier_charges": courier,
        "payment_status": pay_status,
        "due_date": due_date,
        "paid_date": paid_date,
        "payment_mode": pay_mode,
        "paid_amount": paid_amt,
        "items": items
    }

# Server Script: ph_dash
# type: API

ok = False
for r in ["Stock Manager", "Accounts Manager", "Accounts User", "System Manager"]:
    if frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": frappe.session.user, "role": r}):
        ok = True
if not ok:

def one(q, vals=None):
    rows = frappe.db.sql(q, vals or ())
    if rows and rows[0] and rows[0][0] is not None:
        return float(rows[0][0])
    return 0.0

f = frappe.form_dict
today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
d1 = (f.get("from") or today).strip()
d2 = (f.get("to") or today).strip()
p = (d1, d2)
soon = frappe.utils.add_days(today, 90)

inv_total = "sum(if(ifnull(rounded_total, 0) = 0, grand_total, rounded_total))"

sales = one("select " + inv_total + " from `tabSales Invoice` where docstatus = 1 and posting_date between %s and %s", p)
bills = one("select count(*) from `tabSales Invoice` where docstatus = 1 and is_return = 0 and posting_date between %s and %s", p)
purchase = one("select " + inv_total + " from `tabPurchase Invoice` where docstatus = 1 and posting_date between %s and %s", p)

# sales without GST (the sale rate includes GST; the GST rate is kept on the batch)
sales_ex = one("""select sum(sii.amount / (1 + ifnull(b.gst_rate, 0) / 100))
    from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = sii.parent
    left join `tabBatch` b on b.name = sii.batch_no
    where si.docstatus = 1 and si.posting_date between %s and %s""", p)
# cost of goods sold, from the stock ledger
cogs = -one("""select sum(stock_value_difference) from `tabStock Ledger Entry`
    where voucher_type = 'Sales Invoice' and is_cancelled = 0 and posting_date between %s and %s""", p)
expenses = one("""select sum(gl.debit - gl.credit) from `tabGL Entry` gl
    join `tabAccount` a on a.name = gl.account
    where gl.is_cancelled = 0 and a.root_type = 'Expense'
    and ifnull(a.account_type, '') not in ('Cost of Goods Sold', 'Stock Adjustment', 'Round Off')
    and gl.posting_date between %s and %s""", p)

stock_value = one("select sum(stock_value) from `tabBin`")
batch_val = "sum(batch_qty / ifnull(nullif(units_per_pack, 0), 1) * ifnull(net_rate, 0))"
expired = one("select " + batch_val + " from `tabBatch` where disabled = 0 and batch_qty > 0 and expiry_date < %s", (today,))
expiring = one("select " + batch_val + " from `tabBatch` where disabled = 0 and batch_qty > 0 and expiry_date between %s and %s", (today, soon))

cash_bank = one("""select sum(gl.debit - gl.credit) from `tabGL Entry` gl
    join `tabAccount` a on a.name = gl.account
    where gl.is_cancelled = 0 and a.is_group = 0 and a.account_type in ('Cash', 'Bank')""")
receive = one("select sum(outstanding_amount) from `tabSales Invoice` where docstatus = 1")
pay = one("select sum(outstanding_amount) from `tabPurchase Invoice` where docstatus = 1")
if receive < 0:
    receive = 0
if pay < 0:
    pay = 0

company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company") or ""
frappe.response["message"] = {
    "company": company, "from": d1, "to": d2,
    "stock_value": stock_value, "expired": expired, "expiring": expiring,
    "sales": sales, "bills": bills, "purchase": purchase,
    "profit": sales_ex - cogs - expenses, "gross_profit": sales_ex - cogs, "expenses": expenses,
    "cash_bank": cash_bank, "receive": receive, "pay": pay}

# Server Script: ph_purchase_save
# type: API
# doctype: -
# event: Before Insert
# api_method: ph_purchase_save

ok = False
for r in ["Stock User", "Stock Manager", "Accounts User", "Sales User", "Purchase User", "System Manager"]:
    if frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": frappe.session.user, "role": r}):
        ok = True
if not ok:
    frappe.throw("You don't have access to the pharmacy.")

def num(v):
    try:
        return float(v or 0)
    except:
        return 0.0

def batchify(code):
    if not frappe.db.get_value("Item", code, "has_batch_no"):
        it = frappe.get_doc("Item", code)
        it.has_batch_no = 1
        it.has_expiry_date = 1
        it.create_new_batch = 0
        it.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    return code

def ensure_medication_class():
    if not frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Medication Class"):
        return None
    if not frappe.db.exists("Medication Class", "Drug"):
        try:
            mc = frappe.new_doc("Medication Class")
            mc.medication_class = "Drug"
            mc.insert(ignore_permissions=True, ignore_mandatory=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if frappe.db.exists("Medication Class", "Drug"):
        return "Drug"
    return frappe.db.get_value("Medication Class", {}, "name")

def ensure_medication(item_code, item_name):
    if not frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Medication"):
        return
    nm = item_name or item_code
    if frappe.db.exists("Medication", nm) or frappe.db.exists("Medication", {"item": item_code}):
        return
    try:
        med = frappe.new_doc("Medication")
        med.name = nm
        med.flags.name_set = True
        med.medication_name = nm
        med.generic_name = nm
        med.item = item_code
        
        m_class = ensure_medication_class()
        if m_class:
            med.medication_class = m_class
            
        if hasattr(med, "strength"):
            med.strength = 1
            
        med.flags.ignore_mandatory = True
        med.insert(ignore_permissions=True, ignore_mandatory=True)
    except Exception:
        pass

def ensure_item(name):
    if frappe.db.exists("Item", name):
        return batchify(name)
    found = frappe.db.get_value("Item", {"item_name": name}, "name")
    if found:
        return batchify(found)
    
    grp = "Drug"
    if not frappe.db.exists("Item Group", "Drug"):
        grp = frappe.db.get_value("Item Group", {"is_group": 0}, "name")
        
    it = frappe.new_doc("Item")
    it.item_code = name
    it.item_name = name
    it.item_group = grp
    it.stock_uom = "Nos"
    it.is_stock_item = 1
    it.has_batch_no = 1
    it.has_expiry_date = 1
    it.create_new_batch = 0
    it.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    
    ensure_medication(it.name, it.item_name)
    return it.name

def ensure_batch(item, batch_in, expiry, hsn, gst, mrp, rate, net, upp):
    bname = (batch_in or "").strip()
    existing = frappe.db.get_value("Batch", {"batch_id": bname, "item": item}, "name")
    if not existing and frappe.db.exists("Batch", bname):
        if frappe.db.get_value("Batch", bname, "item") == item:
            existing = bname

    meta = frappe.get_meta("Batch")
    def set_batch_fields(doc):
        if expiry:
            doc.expiry_date = expiry
        for fn, val in [("hsn_code", hsn), ("gst_rate", gst), ("mrp", mrp),
                        ("purchase_rate", rate), ("net_rate", net), ("units_per_pack", upp)]:
            if meta.has_field(fn):
                doc.set(fn, val)
            if meta.has_field("custom_" + fn):
                doc.set("custom_" + fn, val)

    if existing:
        b = frappe.get_doc("Batch", existing)
        set_batch_fields(b)
        b.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        return b.name
    else:
        target_name = bname
        if frappe.db.exists("Batch", target_name):
            target_name = bname + "-" + item
            n = 1
            while frappe.db.exists("Batch", target_name):
                target_name = bname + "-" + str(n)
                n += 1
                
        b = frappe.new_doc("Batch")
        b.name = target_name
        b.flags.name_set = True
        b.batch_id = bname
        b.item = item
        set_batch_fields(b)
        b.insert(ignore_permissions=True, ignore_mandatory=True)
        return b.name

f = frappe.form_dict
amend_invoice = (f.get("amend_invoice") or "").strip()
supplier_in = (f.get("supplier") or "").strip()
wh = f.get("warehouse")
lines = json.loads(f.get("lines") or "[]")
if not supplier_in or not wh or not lines:
    frappe.throw("Enter the supplier, the store and at least one line.")

# If amending, verify and cancel the old invoice and linked payment entries FIRST
if amend_invoice:
    if not frappe.db.exists("Purchase Invoice", amend_invoice):
        frappe.throw("Original purchase invoice not found: " + amend_invoice)
    old_pi = frappe.get_doc("Purchase Invoice", amend_invoice)
    pes = frappe.db.sql("""
        select distinct parent from `tabPayment Entry Reference`
        where reference_doctype='Purchase Invoice' and reference_name=%s and docstatus=1
    """, amend_invoice, as_dict=True)
    for p in pes:
        pe_doc = frappe.get_doc("Payment Entry", p.parent)
        if pe_doc.docstatus == 1:
            pe_doc.cancel()
    if old_pi.docstatus == 1:
        old_pi.cancel()

company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
co = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company,
    ["default_payable_account", "stock_received_but_not_billed", "cost_center"], as_dict=True)

supplier = supplier_in
if not frappe.db.exists("Supplier", supplier_in):
    s = frappe.new_doc("Supplier")
    s.supplier_name = supplier_in
    s.supplier_group = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier Group", {"is_group": 0}, "name")
    s.supplier_type = "Company"
    s.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    supplier = s.name

payment_status = f.get("payment_status") or "Paid"
due_date = (f.get("due_date") or "").strip()
paid_date = (f.get("paid_date") or "").strip() or frappe.utils.today()
pay_mode = (f.get("payment_mode") or "").strip() or "Cash"
paid_amt = num(f.get("paid_amount"))

pi = frappe.new_doc("Purchase Invoice")
if amend_invoice:
    pi.amended_from = amend_invoice
pi.supplier = supplier
pi.company = company
pi.posting_date = f.get("bill_date") or frappe.utils.today()
pi.bill_no = (f.get("bill_no") or "").strip()
pi.bill_date = f.get("bill_date") or frappe.utils.today()
if payment_status == "Due" and due_date:
    pi.due_date = due_date
pi.update_stock = 1
pi.set_warehouse = wh

tot_gst = 0.0

for ln in lines:
    upp = int(num(ln.get("upp")))
    if upp < 1:
        upp = 1
    gst = num(ln.get("gst"))
    rate = num(ln.get("rate"))
    if ln.get("basis") == "incl":
        rate = rate / (1 + gst / 100)
    net = rate * (1 - num(ln.get("disc")) / 100)
    qty = num(ln.get("packs")) * upp + num(ln.get("units"))
    if qty <= 0:
        frappe.throw("Enter a quantity for " + (ln.get("product") or "every line") + ".")
        
    item = ensure_item((ln.get("product") or "").strip())
    raw_batch = (ln.get("batch") or "").strip()
    exp = (ln.get("expiry") or "").strip()
    hsn = (ln.get("hsn") or "").strip()
    mrp = num(ln.get("mrp"))
    
    batch_name = ensure_batch(item, raw_batch, exp, hsn, gst, mrp, rate, net, upp)
    
    item_row = {
        "item_code": item,
        "qty": qty,
        "rate": net / upp,
        "warehouse": wh,
        "batch_no": batch_name,
        "expense_account": co.stock_received_but_not_billed,
        "cost_center": co.cost_center
    }
    pi.append("items", item_row)
    
    line_subtotal = (qty / upp) * net
    tot_gst += line_subtotal * (gst / 100.0)

if tot_gst > 0:
    cgst_acc = frappe.db.get_value("Account", {
        "account_name": ["in", ["Input Tax CGST", "CGST", "Input CGST"]],
        "company": company,
        "is_group": 0
    }, "name")
    sgst_acc = frappe.db.get_value("Account", {
        "account_name": ["in", ["Input Tax SGST", "SGST", "Input SGST"]],
        "company": company,
        "is_group": 0
    }, "name")
    
    if cgst_acc and sgst_acc:
        half = round(tot_gst / 2.0, 2)
        other_half = round(tot_gst - half, 2)
        pi.append("taxes", {
            "category": "Total",
            "charge_type": "Actual",
            "account_head": cgst_acc,
            "description": "Input CGST",
            "tax_amount": half,
            "cost_center": co.cost_center
        })
        pi.append("taxes", {
            "category": "Total",
            "charge_type": "Actual",
            "account_head": sgst_acc,
            "description": "Input SGST",
            "tax_amount": other_half,
            "cost_center": co.cost_center
        })
    else:
        gst_acc = frappe.db.get_value("Account", {
            "account_name": ["like", "%GST%"],
            "company": company,
            "is_group": 0
        }, "name") or frappe.db.get_value("Account", {
            "account_type": "Tax",
            "company": company,
            "is_group": 0
        }, "name") or co.stock_received_but_not_billed

        pi.append("taxes", {
            "category": "Total",
            "charge_type": "Actual",
            "account_head": gst_acc,
            "description": "Input GST",
            "tax_amount": round(tot_gst, 2),
            "cost_center": co.cost_center
        })

disc_pct = num(f.get("discount_percentage"))
disc_amt = num(f.get("discount_amount"))
if disc_pct > 0:
    pi.apply_discount_on = "Grand Total"
    pi.additional_discount_percentage = disc_pct
elif disc_amt > 0:
    pi.apply_discount_on = "Grand Total"
    pi.discount_amount = disc_amt

courier = num(f.get("courier_charges"))
if courier > 0:
    expense_acc = frappe.db.get_value("Account", {
        "account_name": ["in", ["Freight and Forwarding Charges", "Expenses Included In Valuation", "Courier Charges"]],
        "company": company,
        "is_group": 0
    }, "name") or co.stock_received_but_not_billed

    pi.append("taxes", {
        "category": "Valuation and Total",
        "charge_type": "Actual",
        "account_head": expense_acc,
        "description": "Courier / Freight Charges",
        "tax_amount": courier,
        "cost_center": co.cost_center
    })

pi.run_method("set_missing_values")
if not pi.credit_to:
    pi.credit_to = co.default_payable_account

pi.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
pi.submit()

# Auto-record Payment Entry if Paid
if payment_status == "Paid" and paid_amt > 0:
    paid_from_acc = frappe.db.get_value("Mode of Payment Account", {"parent": pay_mode, "company": company}, "default_account")
    if not paid_from_acc:
        paid_from_acc = frappe.db.get_value("Account", {"account_type": "Cash", "company": company, "is_group": 0}, "name")
        
    if paid_from_acc:
        pe = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
        pe.payment_type = "Pay"
        pe.company = company
        pe.posting_date = paid_date
        pe.party_type = "Supplier"
        pe.party = supplier
        pe.mode_of_payment = pay_mode
        pe.paid_from = paid_from_acc
        pe.paid_to = pi.credit_to
        pe.paid_amount = paid_amt
        pe.received_amount = paid_amt
        pe.reference_no = pi.bill_no or pi.name
        pe.reference_date = pi.bill_date or paid_date
        pe.append("references", {
            "reference_doctype": "Purchase Invoice",
            "reference_name": pi.name,
            "total_amount": pi.rounded_total or pi.grand_total,
            "outstanding_amount": pi.rounded_total or pi.grand_total,
            "allocated_amount": paid_amt
        })
        pe.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        pe.submit()

frappe.response["message"] = {"invoice": pi.name, "total": pi.rounded_total or pi.grand_total}
